measured_source_verification.method: Each recorded source SHA-256 was compared with the corresponding immutable Git blob; the system harness is bound separately below.

system_harness.change_reason: Ruff RUF021 only: added parentheses around isinstance(gateway.raw_output, str) and bool(gateway.raw_output), the right operand of the existing or expression inside inference_confirmed. Python operator precedence already produced the same expression; ast.dump without source-position attributes is identical. The measured bytes remain those in the measured commit, not the later byte-different formatting edit.

reproduction.output_requirement: Use a fresh output file for each reproduction; the helper refuses overwriting an existing file. The helper creates missing parent directories. Both input and output are explicit, so original scratch defaults are unused.
reproduction.byte_reproduction_note: The recorded original derived SHA-256 binds the original analysis file. Reproduction generates a new analysis_created_at; raw_reports.*.path also varies when the checkout moves. Compare the preserved raw input hashes and numerical results rather than expecting byte-identical regenerated analysis.
